Twisting injury playing netball 4 months ago. Ongoing instability and a positive Lachman test. ? ACL tear.
Multiplanar multisequence MRI of the left knee on a 3T scanner. No contrast.
Anterior cruciate ligament: complete tear of the proximal fibres, with no intact fibres in continuity.
Collateral ligaments: medial collateral ligament low-grade sprain; lateral collateral ligament intact.
Bone: bone marrow oedema in the lateral femoral condyle and posterolateral tibial plateau, in keeping with a pivot-shift injury. No fracture.
1. Complete ACL tear with a pivot-shift bone bruise pattern.
